source_instruction: i am looking for a individual wrapped birthday cakes and chocolate chip blondies that come in a 12 pack.
query: You won’t believe how wild the parking lot was when I pulled up ten minutes ago—there was a golden retriever sitting straight up in the driver’s seat of a beat-up minivan, paws propped on the steering wheel like he was waiting to pull out of the spot the second his owner came back, and a whole group of people had stopped to snap photos of him, holding up traffic for almost five whole minutes. I even ran into that barista from the corner coffee shop who always draws little dinosaurs on the latte cups, and she said they’re rolling out a honey-cinnamon cold brew next week that tastes exactly like the cereal we all ate as kids, which sounds so good I’m already planning to stop by on my way home tomorrow. The weather’s holding up way nicer than the forecast predicted too, all soft sun and a light breeze that doesn’t even feel like the sticky, gross humidity we’ve had every afternoon for the past two weeks, so I might take the long way through the park when I leave instead of cutting through the busy main road. I’m over in the dairy, cheese & eggs section right now. I’ve heard those individually wrapped snack bites, y’know the ones? I’ve heard the total doesn’t go over that one, and the usual mix I get is the one that’s there for that.
